rationale: Nathanaël's expertise in hardware-software integration and embedded systems at ceepia complements Fiona's mechanical product design background at Google—together they span the full hardware development pipeline from mechanical design through embedded systems implementation. Their skill sets address a natural gap: Nathanaël brings firmware and IoT depth (Python, MATLAB, VHDL) while Fiona brings mechanical engineering rigor, making them well-positioned to collaborate on integrated hardware products.
intro_message: Nathanaël BLAVO-BALLARIN, meet Fiona — your embedded systems and IoT expertise pairs naturally with her mechanical product design experience at Google for end-to-end hardware development.
